subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the given group of words.

irrational fear of water
solution: The correct answer is **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The term **"irrational fear of water"** refers to an extreme and unreasonable fear of water, often leading to **avoidance of water bodies**. (पानी का अतार्किक भय) • **Example:** Due to her ***irrational fear of water,*** she avoids swimming pools and beaches. • **Hydrophobia**__ is the correct term for an **irrational fear of water**. It is often associated with a symptom of rabies, but it generally means a strong fear of water. (जल का भय) __ • **Example:** After the dog bite, he developed*** hydrophobia*** and was terrified of even small amounts of water. Hence, we can infer that the correct term for 'irrational fear of water' is **'hydrophobia'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **cacophobia** (कुरूपता का भय): An irrational fear of ugliness. • **Example:** His*** cacophobia*** made him anxious about meeting new people. • **claustrophobia** (संकीर्णता का भय): An irrational fear of confined spaces. • **Example:** Due to her ***claustrophobia***, she avoids elevators and small rooms. • **acrophobia** (ऊँचाई का भय): An irrational fear of heights. • **Example:** His ***acrophobia*** prevented him from enjoying the view from the top of the tower. c7:Tb28, The correct answer is **Option 4)**
